criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in/edit; stop after recording requested info)
criteria.final_justification: No evidence of signing in or editing. The agent did stop after presenting an answer; however, it did not correctly handle unverified tags (tourism/museum/website). This does not violate the no-edit/no-login constraint, but it does mean they effectively ‘stopped’ without reliably recording all requested tag values. Minor deduction is appropriate rather than full loss because the constraint focus is primarily no sign-in/edit.
